_about: Public-domain Thomas Comber (1645-1699), Dean of Durham, liturgist, for the Word Hoard: A Companion to the Temple, or a help to devotion in the daily use of the Common Prayer (London 1676) and A Companion to the Altar (London 1675), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 42 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

comber-companion-temple-1676: A companion to the temple, or A help to devotion, in the daily use of the common prayer : in two parts : part I containing the morning and evening prayer (London : Printed by Andrew Clark for Henry Brome ..., 1676)
comber-companion-altar-1675: A companion to the altar, or, An help to the worthy receiving of the Lords Supper by discourses and meditations upon the whole communion office : to which is added an essay upon the offices of baptism and confirmation (London : Printed by J. Macock for John Martyn ... and Richard Lambert ..., 1675)

_alternates.comber-copies: The other 1676 copy; the Oxford 1841 Companion to the Temple; the 1906 Exposition of Morning and Evening Prayer (an extract)
